notes: S3 (blob codes; decision 2026-11-16 #44; MW2 reviews A and B): blob A is listed and stored; the container also holds a copy of the listed blob under its name in uppercase hex, in the zip form (the directory form cannot hold both names on a case-insensitive file system).
